name: Loose Fit Jeans
description:

Loose-fit jeans crafted from raw cotton denim. This provides a rigid feel during initial wear, which will soften over time with use. Straight leg from hip to ankle, with a fit that neither tapers nor flares. Mid-rise. Rigid fabric.

Five-pocket style. Contrasting topstitching. Front zip fly and button closure.
